bugs.name: Milestone search treats % and _ as SQL wildcards instead of literal characters
bugs.summary: The search box passes % and _ to the database as wildcards. Searching "%" lists every open milestone (tab went from 2 results for 'R3-' to '18 Open / 1 Closed'), searching "_" lists every open milestone, and searching "R3_alp" wrongly matches the milestone "R3-alpha due date" (the underscore matched the hyphen). (on /eval/harbor-handbook/milestones)
bugs.expected: The search box matches milestone titles literally against the typed text: "%" and "_" are ordinary characters, so a search for "%" or "_" finds only milestones whose title contains them (none here), and "R3_alp" finds nothing because no title contains "R3_alp".
bugs.actual: The search box passes % and _ to the database as wildcards. Searching "%" lists every open milestone (tab went from 2 results for 'R3-' to '18 Open / 1 Closed'), searching "_" lists every open milestone, and searching "R3_alp" wrongly matches the milestone "R3-alpha due date" (the underscore matched the hyphen).
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1 and open https://5503-i63ver939iyt829xccz92.e2b.app/eval/harbor-handbook/milestones?state=open
Type R3- in the 'Search...' box and press Enter: 2 milestones are listed ('2 Open'), which is correct
Replace the query with a single underscore (_) and press Enter, or open ?state=open&q=_ : '18 Open' and every milestone is listed although no title contains an underscore
Replace the query with R3_alp and press Enter, or open ?state=open&q=R3_alp : the milestone 'R3-alpha due date' is listed, although its title does not contain 'R3_alp'
Replace the query with a single percent sign (%) and press Enter, or open ?state=open&q=%25 : every milestone is listed although no title contains '%'
